title: Sleep Debt Accumulation Watch
dataSources: Apple Health metrics (`apple:health`), Oura Ring daily readiness/sleep (`oura:daily`), WHOOP recovery/strain (`whoop:cycle`), Withings body and blood-pressure (`withings:measure`), Dexcom CGM glucose (`dexcom:egv`).
app: Apple Health / Apple Watch exports (Health Auto Export, Shortcuts) via HEC; Oura, WHOOP, Withings, and Dexcom APIs via scripted REST inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=oura:daily
| eval sleep_debt=target_sleep_hours-sleep_hours
| where sleep_debt>0
| sort 0 user _time
| streamstats window=7 sum(sleep_debt) as debt_7d by user
| where debt_7d>5
| sort - _time
description: Adds up your past week's sleep shortfall and flags when the debt has become large enough that caffeine and optimism are no longer hiding it.
value: A single short night is normal; accumulated debt is where mood, focus, and immune resilience begin to suffer in a measurable way.
implementation: Forward Oura daily totals with target sleep hours; schedule each morning and alert when rolling sleep debt gets too high.
visualization: Daily line chart of seven-day sleep debt.
grandmaExplanation: It watches when too many slightly short nights pile up into a bigger sleep debt that your body can feel.
